title: Get started with MCP server management
content_data:
This article outlines what you need to prepare to ensure your Model Context Protocol (MCP) server registration on the developer portal goes smoothly. ## Prerequisites Before you can register MCP servers on the TikTok for Business Developers portal, you must: 1. [Create a TikTok for Business account](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/create-a-tiktok-for-business-account/v1.3). This gives you access to the TikTok for Business ecosystem. 2. [Register as a developer](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/register-as-a-developer/v1.3). This unlocks the **My Agentic Hub** module and MCP server registration capabilities. > **Note**
> If you have previously used any TikTok API for Business endpoints, you already meet both prerequisites and can proceed directly to preparing your MCP server infrastructure. ## Prepare your MCP server infrastructure To prevent delays during the review process, we strongly recommend preparing the following four components before you begin the registration form: ```xtable |Category{25%}|What you need{30%}|Action required{45%}| |---|---|---| |Endpoint and network configuration|A remote MCP server URL that uses the Streamable HTTP transport protocol.|Ensure you have set up a remote MCP server URL that uses the Streamable HTTP transport protocol.| |Tools configuration CSV|A completed CSV file that maps out every tool your server offers. Download the official [Tools Configuration Template](https://bytedance.my.larkoffice.com/sheets/AIgpsEGB8hPxbmt1tO0mWtC4yHh).|Include the following for every single tool:

• The `tool_name` and the exact `tool_signature` (for example, `get_order_summary(store_id: string)`).

• A clear `display_title` and a human-readable `description`.

• The `safety_annotation`, which must be written exactly as `readOnlyHint`, `writeHint`, or `destructiveHint`.

• An `example_prompt` and the `expected_tool_sequence`.| |Authentication setup|A finalized decision on how your server handles user security.|• If your tools only provide public data, select "No authentication".

• If they access specific advertiser data, set up OAuth 2.0/2.1 with PKCE. Keep your Authorization URL accessible, as it is required for the registration form. Additionally, you must allowlist TikTok's redirect URI (https://business.tiktok.com/agentic/oauth/callback) in your identity provider settings to ensure the OAuth handshake succeeds.| |Test account credentials|A dedicated test account configured specifically for the TikTok review team.|Create a secure test environment populated with representative sample data. Document the exact login credentials and step-by-step instructions for testing your tools. Missing or invalid test credentials are the most common cause of review delays.| |Legal and support documentation|• Documentation URL: The URL to the official documentation page for your MCP server.

• Privacy policy URL: The link to the privacy policy document for your MCP server.

• Terms of service URL: The link to the terms of service document for your MCP server.

• Support channel: The URL or email address for your helpdesk, community forum, or dedicated support inbox.|• Ensure your official documentation is publicly accessible and clearly explains how to use your server's tools.

• Your privacy policy must be live and accurately describe your data handling practices.

• Provide a valid link to the terms of service governing the use of your MCP server.

• Establish a clear channel where advertisers can reach out for technical assistance.| ``` ## Next steps Once your MCP server infrastructure is ready, proceed to [Register MCP servers](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/register-mcp-servers/v1.3).
